description: Platform-specific native engines for the SelectPdf.Universal and SelectPdf.HtmlToPdf.Universal libraries, for the linux-x64 runtime: the Chromium engine for HTML to PDF and HTML to image (with its in-process host library), and the PDF tool for PDF to text and PDF to image. The files are copied next to your application automatically. The Linux packages bundle the Chromium shared libraries, so no system packages are needed. The Chromium engine runs inside the application when the package matches the architecture of the application process; with a package of another architecture conversions run in a separate engine process. Install the managed SelectPdf.Universal or SelectPdf.HtmlToPdf.Universal package plus this package matching your runtime.
summary: SelectPdf native rendering engines (Chromium CEF + PDF tool) for the linux-x64 runtime.
title: SelectPdf Native Engines (linux-x64)
